title: Oh so when they said couture they meant COUTURE! #MasqueradeNYC #Imme...
transcript: We just got a very cryptic post from a masquerade, the immersive Phantom of the opera experience, revealing this mask. Now, obviously, it is like a couture version of the classic Phantom of the opera mask, but exactly how it's going to be used in the experience experience is still a bit of a mystery. It was revealed by Nicola Formichetti, who is a couture fashion designer who has created looks for many celebrities, including this Lil NAS X outfit, as well as this iconic Lady Gaga look. He is very accomplished and has revealed that he has been appointed the director of masks. And he says that over the past couple months, he's been making many versions of masks for The Phantom of the opera and is still unsure which one he's going to choose. Given that this is the one that they chose to show off, I think we can safely assume one of two things. Either one, this is the mask that the Phantom will wear during the experience, which would be kind of weird and funky, but I'm into it. Or number two, this could be what the couture masks that they are selling look like, because one of their add ons is you can choose to buy a couture mask, and this is about as couture as it comes. Now, they did say that no phantom masks were allowed, so that is why I'm not sure that this will actually be the mask that they Sell. But whichever mask they do end up selling, I think we can safely say it will be designed by him. And I will say having a mask that is designed by a famous celebrity fashion designer is genuinely really cool. But what do you guys think?
